About TBH

A neighbourhood bakery in the heart of Gulberg III

TBH – The Bakery House is located on Riaz Ali Sheikh Road, Block N, Gulberg III, Lahore. It is known for delightful and scrumptious treats — from everyday buttercakes and cupcakes to custom and hand-painted cakes made for special occasions.

Whether it is a birthday, a family gathering, or simply chai-time at home, TBH is open every single day to serve the neighbourhood.

  • Custom & painted cakes made to order
  • Cupcakes, cream cakes & buttercakes
  • Open 7 days a week, 11 AM – 11 PM
